O que é Heartopia?

Heartopia is a relaxing slow-life simulation game from XD. The official site presents it as a calm social and creative life-sim experience with fashion, in-game footage, and multi-language support. Fan sites commonly track PC, iOS, Android, and Steam rotas, plus códigos, hobbies, pets, casa planning, and wiki databases.

FAQ

Is this an official Heartopia website?

No. Heartopia Hub is an independent fan resource. It is not affiliated with XD, the developer, publisher, or official Heartopia channels.

Are all códigos guaranteed ativos today?

No. Códigos are pulled from public fan trackers and can expire without notice. The useful part is the priority, expiry note, reward category, and source date so jogadores know what to test first.

Why include database rows if the full game data is still changing?

Because a good guia site should be transparent about sample size. This launch version gives verified-style tables and clear update paths, then can expand into hundreds of item, peixes, receita, NPC, and pet rows later.

title: About Heartopia Hub
description: About Heartopia Hub, an independent fan resource with editorial standards for Heartopia códigos, guias, ferramentas, and database pages.
content:
Editorial transparency

About Heartopia Hub

Heartopia Hub is an independent fan resource built to help jogadores find practical, verified, and clearly explained Heartopia information.

What We Publish

We publish beginner guias, code verification notas, mapa planning frameworks, lightweight ferramentas, and database standards. The goal is to explain player decisions, not simply repeat names, numbers, or rumor posts from other sites.

Editorial Method

  • Code claims are separated into verified, expirado, and unverified states.
  • Guias explain tradeoffs, assumptions, and update timing.
  • Banco de dados pages should include source confidence and practical player advice before publication.
  • Thin placeholder pages should stay unpublished or noindexed until they have useful content.

Independence

This website is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or operated by Heartopia, the game's developer, or its publisher. Names and game references are used for identification and fan commentary.

title: Privacy Policy - Heartopia Hub
description: Privacy Policy for Heartopia Hub, including cookies, analytics, advertising, AdSense, and user choices.
content:
Last updated junho 5, 2026

Privacy Policy

This policy explains what Heartopia Hub collects, how advertising may work, and how visitors can control cookies and personalized ads.

Information We Collect

This static website does not require an account and does not ask for passwords, game account data, payment details, or personal profile information. If you contact the site dono by email, your message and email address may be used to respond to your request.

Cookies And Analytics

The atual version does not include analytics scripts. If analytics are added later, this policy should be updated to name the provider, explain the data collected, and describe opt-out choices.

Google AdSense And Advertising

When Google AdSense or other advertising partners are enabled, third-party vendors may use cookies or similar technologies to serve ads based on a visitor's prior visits to this and other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on visits to this site and other sites on the internet.

Visitors can review ad personalization choices through Google's advertising settings and can learn more about third-party advertising choices through recognized industry opt-out resources. If this site serves users in regiões with additional consent requirements, a compliant consent mechanism should be added before personalized advertising is enabled.

External Links

This site may link to official game pages, publisher channels, and community resources. External websites have their own privacy practices and are not controlled by Heartopia Hub.

Contato

For privacy questions, use the contact page or email contact@heartopia.blog.
